description: This Java class handles the command where an applicant withdraws from a savings account application. It is a command handler that processes withdrawal actions for savings accounts, utilizing a service to perform the withdrawal logic.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationWithdrawnByApplicantCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles withdrawal commands initiated by an applicant for savings accounts, delegating processing to the savings application service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the withdrawal command, triggering the savings application service to perform the withdrawal based on the command's entity ID and details.
